svg.title: From one DAG to a sorted list to parallel execution
svg.desc: The input is one action DAG. Topological sorting turns it into one list. The response keeps the list and each node's parents, and execution starts every node whose parents are done.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: It is one graph: Y1 -> A3, A3 -> B3 and A4 -> Y2 link the three lanes. A graph with

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: no links at all would simply be a DAG in which nothing waits for anything.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 2 · events.GetTopologicalOrdering(): one flat list, every edge points right

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: That is all a topological sort returns: positions 0..9. No times, no 'parallel' marks.

g.text: Nodes with no parents (Y1, A1, B1) can start immediately. Every parent index is smaller than the node's own index, because the list is topologically sorted. The list order and the parents together are the 'sorted graph'.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The scheduler builds Schedule.nodes this way in BuildScheduledActionsArray: it walks the action DAG in topological order, gives each node its position, and fills parents from the node's in-edges plus the previous

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: action of the same AGV, bay or VRC. How Dispatch executes the schedule is outside this package.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: From one DAG to a sorted list to parallel execution

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Topological sorting does not create parallelism and does not remove it. It only lists the nodes so that every edge points forward. Parallelism comes from the DAG itself: nodes with no

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: path between them may run at the same time, and the parents field carries that into the response.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: t = 0: Y1, A1 and B1 have no parents, so all three start together

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
